name: submit_intake
description: Send everything learned on the call to the planner. Call once, after the recap. Leave out fields you did not learn.

summary.description: One-sentence recap as agreed with the caller.

is_owner.description: True if the caller owns the home.

address.description: Postcode, or street and town if they gave it, e.g. '85579' or 'Hauptstr. 5, Neubiberg'.

num_inhabitants.description: People living in the home; 5 or more = 5. If unknown, estimate from consumption and list as estimated.

home_office.description: Someone is usually home during the day, e.g. working from home.

house_size_sqm.description: Living area in m2 as they said it. Only if they picked a band: under 100 = 90, 100 to 150 = 125, 150 to 200 = 175, over 200 = 220.

house_built_year.description: Build year; a decade becomes its middle year, e.g. the eighties = 1985.

monthly_bill_eur.description: Monthly electricity payment in EUR, as said.

annual_demand_kwh.description: Household electricity per year in kWh, stated or estimated.

heating_age.description: Age of the current boiler or heater.

heating_demand_kwh.description: Yearly heating use in kWh; gas m3 and oil litres times 10.

ev.description: Electric car now, planned, or none.

ev_planned_when.description: When the planned car arrives, as said.

ev_annual_km.description: Kilometres a year as they said it. Only if they picked a band: under 10k = 8000, 10 to 15k = 12500, over 15k = 18000.

existing_solar_kwp.description: Size of existing solar in kWp.

preference.description: What matters most: grid independence, fastest payback, or lowest upfront cost.

timeline.description: When they want it, as said.

budget_monthly_eur.description: Monthly payment that would feel comfortable if financed, only if they gave one.

budget.description: Budget comfort, only if they offered it.

notes.description: Anything else a planner should know.

estimated_fields.description: Names of fields you estimated, converted or took from a band. Every other field counts as stated.
